statement: Count the Omer: forty-nine days from the sheaf offering
note: Counting reads as a standing annual observance like festival rules labelled Torah Law; catalogue treats it as procedure (Deut 16:9 attached).

statement: Bring the two Shavuot loaves with their accompanying offerings
note: C0686 the two loaves; C0687 the offerings accompanying them (Lev 23:18-19), which Maimonides includes here.

statement: Rest from work on Shavuot
note: Maimonides derives positive rest from 'holy convocation': C0689 assembly, C0690 no work (Num 28:26 attached).

statement: Do not work on Shavuot
note: Direct match; Num 28:26 attached.

statement: Do not reap the corner (peah) of the field
note: C0597 (Lev 19:9) carries Lev 23:22 as additional Scripture.

statement: Rest from work on Rosh Hashanah (first of seventh month)
note: Holy assembly (C0692), memorial day (C0691) and no-work rule (C0693) cover the day's rest; Num 29:1 attached.

statement: Do not work on Rosh Hashanah
note: Direct match; Num 29:1 attached.

statement: Do not work on the Day of Atonement
Do not eat or drink on the Day of Atonement
note: C0568 holds 23:29 and requires self-humbling (fasting); no separate prohibition record, but the content is the same.

statement: Rest from work on the first day of Sukkot
note: C0697 holy assembly and C0698 no work on the first and eighth days.

statement: Do not work on the first day of Sukkot
note: Direct match; Num 29:12 attached.

statement: Bring the additional offerings on the seven days of Passover
note: Listed verse Lev 23:36 concerns Booths; Passover additional offerings itemized by C0681 (Lev 23:8; Num 28:19-24).

statement: Rest from work on the eighth day (Shemini Atzeret)
note: Same records as the first day: assemblies and no work on the eighth day (Num 29:35 attached).

statement: Do not work on the eighth day (Shemini Atzeret)
note: Direct match.

statement: Take the four species (lulav) on Sukkot
note: Annual observance binding all Israel, like dwelling in booths (C0704, Torah Law), yet labelled Instruction.

statement: Dwell in a sukkah seven days
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not blaspheme (curse) the divine Name
note: C0710 forbids cursing God; C0709 the stoning penalty. Ex 22:27 record C0208 keeps the rendering 'gods'.

statement: Do not work (sow) the land in the sabbatical year
note: C0712 no sowing; C0227 land rest (Lev 25:2-4 attached).

statement: Do not work trees (prune vines) in the sabbatical year
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not reap aftergrowth in the sabbatical year as normal
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not gather vine or tree fruit normally in the sabbatical year
note: Direct match.

statement: Count seven sabbatical cycles of years to the Jubilee
note: Count under Instruction while Jubilee rules (C0718, C0721-C0723) are Torah Law; arguably procedural, flagged for review.

statement: Sound the shofar on the Jubilee Day of Atonement
note: Jubilee shofar proclamation under Instruction while the Jubilee ordinance (C0718) is Torah Law; arguably procedural, flagged for review.

statement: Sanctify the fiftieth (Jubilee) year
note: Direct match; proclaiming release is Command C0719.

statement: Do not work (sow) the land in the Jubilee year
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not reap Jubilee-year aftergrowth as normal
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not gather Jubilee-year fruit as normal
note: Direct match.

statement: Conduct buying and selling according to Torah law
note: No record states the general law of sale; AUD-03-25-14 holds 25:14 but states the overreaching ban (N250).

statement: Do not overcharge or wrong anyone in buying and selling
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not wrong anyone with words
note: Same verse and prohibition; Maimonides reads 25:17 as verbal wronging, the record says oppression generally.

statement: Do not sell land in Israel permanently
note: Direct match.

statement: Return land to owners at Jubilee and allow its redemption
note: C0727 land redemption (holds 25:24); C0720 restoration at Jubilee.

statement: Walled-city house sales are redeemable only within one year
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not sell or alter the Levite cities' open land
note: List gives Lev 25:33; the prohibition is 25:34, itemized by C0730.

statement: Do not lend at interest
note: C0206 (Ex 22:24) carries Lev 25:36-37 and Deut 23:20.

statement: Do not work a Hebrew servant with degrading slave labour
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not sell a Hebrew servant as slaves are sold
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not work a Hebrew servant harshly
note: Direct match.

statement: Keep Canaanite slaves in permanent service
note: C0736 covers 25:44-46 (permanent holding and inheritance of foreign slaves).

statement: Do not let a gentile owner work a Hebrew servant harshly
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not bow down on a figured stone
note: Direct match; pillar ban C0738 shares the verse.

statement: Apply the valuation laws for vowed persons
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not substitute another animal for a consecrated one
note: Direct match; tithe-animal parallel C0761.

statement: Apply the valuation laws for consecrated animals
note: Valuation itself is Instruction C0743; Torah Law C0744 covers only the added fifth. Person and field valuations (C0740, C0747) are Torah Law.

statement: Apply the valuation laws for consecrated houses
note: Valuation itself is Instruction C0745; Torah Law C0746 covers only the added fifth. Person and field valuations are Torah Law.

statement: Apply the valuation laws for consecrated fields
note: C0747 ancestral field (27:16-18); C0751 purchased field (27:22-23).

statement: Apply the laws of devoted (cherem) property
note: AUD-04-18-14 gives devoted things to priests; C0750 the unredeemed field; C0755/C0756 are the negatives.

statement: Do not transfer a consecrated animal to another offering
note: C0753 states the firstborn case (27:26) from which Maimonides derives the general ban on reassigning consecrated animals.

statement: Do not sell a devoted (cherem) field or thing
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not redeem a devoted (cherem) field or thing
note: Direct match.

statement: Separate the first tithe for the Levites
note: C0882 gives the tithe to the Levites; C0759 declares the produce tithe holy (Lev 27:30).

statement: Separate the tithe of cattle and sheep
note: C0759 carries Lev 27:32 and names the livestock tithe.

statement: A substitute for a consecrated animal is also holy
note: C0742 (27:10) and C0762 (27:33, tithe animal).

statement: Do not sell the animal tithe
note: C0763 forbids redeeming the tithe animal (same clause); Maimonides reads 'not redeemed' as also banning its sale.

statement: Send the ritually impure out of the camp (sanctuary)
note: Only Command C0796; parallel exclusion rules are Torah Law (C0494 leper outside camp, C1151 no re-entry), so this standing rule reads as Law.

statement: An impure person must not enter the sanctuary camp
note: C0796 holds 5:3 but states sending out; Torah Law bans on entering cover only postpartum (C0482) and corpse cases (AUD-04-19-13).

statement: Confess one's sin before God
note: Itemized by Lev 5:5 confession record C0410; Num 5:6-7 confession itself has only topical study S102 and a historical study.

statement: Follow the procedure for the suspected adulteress (sotah)
note: Ordeal steps itemized as Mosaic Instruction records C0799-C0810; procedural, so not flagged.

statement: Do not put oil on the sotah's meal offering
note: Exact parallel ban for the sinner's flour offering (C0418, Lev 5:11) is Torah Law, but this one is Instruction.

statement: Do not put frankincense on the sotah's meal offering
note: Exact parallel ban (C0419, Lev 5:11) is Torah Law, but the jealousy-offering ban is Instruction.

statement: Nazirite must not drink wine or grape-derived drink
note: C0811 wine and strong drink; C0812 vinegars.

statement: Nazirite must not eat fresh grapes
note: C0813 context names fresh grapes.

statement: Nazirite must not eat raisins
note: C0813 context names raisins.

statement: Nazirite must not eat grape seeds
note: Covered within C0813's 'other vine products' (holds 6:4); seeds not named separately.

statement: Nazirite must not eat grape skins
note: Covered within C0813's 'other vine products' (holds 6:4); skins not named separately.

statement: Nazirite lets his hair grow
note: Direct match.

statement: Nazirite must not shave his hair
note: Direct match.

statement: Nazirite must not defile himself for the dead, even relatives
note: Direct match (Num 6:6-7).

statement: Nazirite shaves and brings offerings at the vow's completion
note: Completion shaving and offerings are Instruction (C0822, C0821); procedure, not flagged.

statement: Priests bless Israel with the priestly blessing
note: Standing priestly duty under Instruction (Commission AUD-05-10-8 also names blessing); comparable priestly duty C0846 (trumpets) is Torah Law.

statement: Carry the ark on the shoulders
note: Carrying holy things on shoulders is Instruction/Command/Commission; a transport specification, so not flagged.

statement: Do not leave second-Passover meat until morning
note: List's verse Num 9:3 looks off; the law is Num 9:12, carried by C0099.

statement: Slaughter the second Passover (Pesach Sheni) offering
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not break a bone of the second Passover offering
note: C0101 carries Num 9:12.

statement: Sound trumpets over offerings and in times of trouble
note: C0846 (Law) sets the perpetual trumpet office; the occasions, war alarm and festival offerings, are Instruction C0847/C0848.

statement: Separate challah from dough for the priest
note: Direct match.

statement: Wear fringes (tzitzit) on four-cornered garments
note: Direct match; Deut 22:12 attached.

statement: Do not stray after your heart and eyes
note: Covenant charge under Command; catalogue treats similar heart charges (coveting C0158) as Command, so not flagged.

statement: Levites and priests must not do each other's work
note: C0873 states the Levite side (no priestly access to vessels and altar).

statement: Guard the sanctuary (Levitical watch)
note: Guard duty only as Command C0772 (Num 1:53; 3:7-8); C0874 holds 18:4 but states the outsider ban (N74).

statement: A non-priest must not serve in the sanctuary
note: C0874 (18:4, 22) and C0770 death liability for intrusion.

statement: Do not leave the sanctuary unguarded
note: Only positive Command charges (C0774 holds 18:5; C0772 Levite guard); Maimonides reads 'keep the charge' as forbidding an unguarded sanctuary.

statement: Do not redeem firstborn clean animals
note: Direct match.

statement: Levites perform their service in the sanctuary
note: Only Command C0768 and Commission AUD-05-10-8; Torah Law C0840 covers service ages only; the 18:23 clause has no record.

statement: Levites give a tithe of their tithe to the priests
note: Direct match.

statement: Prepare the red heifer and its ashes
note: Rite itemized step by step as Instruction (C0885-C0893); procedural, not flagged.

statement: Apply the laws of the purification (sprinkling) water
note: C0903 (Law) states the water defiles whoever touches it; its purifying use is Instruction C0896.

statement: Apply the laws of corpse impurity
note: C0895 carries Num 19:14, 16; C0897 open vessels.

statement: Apply the Torah's order of inheritance
note: Direct match.

statement: Offer the two daily (tamid) lambs
note: Only Instruction C0333 (Num 28:3-8 attached), while Lev 23 festival offerings (C0681, C0694, C0699) are Torah Law.

statement: Bring the additional offering on the Day of Atonement
note: List's Num 28:7-8 (daily libation) looks like a typo for 29:7-8; C0696 carries Num 29:8-11.

statement: Bring the additional Sabbath offering
note: Only Instruction C0928; festival additional offerings are Torah Law (C0694, C0696, C0699), so labelling is inconsistent.

statement: Bring the additional new-moon offering
note: Only Instruction C0929; festival additional offerings are Torah Law elsewhere, so labelling is inconsistent.

statement: Bring the additional Shavuot offering
note: Only Instruction AUD-04-28-27; Torah Law C0687 covers the Lev 23:18-19 loaves offerings, which Maimonides counts under P46.

statement: Bring the additional Rosh Hashanah offering
note: C0694 carries Num 29:2-6.

statement: Hear the shofar on Rosh Hashanah
note: C0691 keeps the day as a 'trumpet memorial' (Num 29:1 attached); no record states the sounding itself.

statement: Bring the additional Sukkot offerings
note: C0699 carries Num 29:13-34.

statement: Bring the additional Shemini Atzeret offering
note: C0700 carries Num 29:36-38.

statement: Apply the laws of annulling vows
note: Annulment rules for a daughter's and a wife's vows; release of vows by a sage is not itemized.

statement: Do not break one's vow or oath
note: Direct match; Deut 23:23-24 attached.

statement: Give the Levites cities and surrounding land
note: Direct match.

statement: Do not execute anyone before trial and conviction
note: Direct match.

statement: Exile the accidental killer to a city of refuge
note: Return to the refuge city (C1249) and residence until the high priest dies (C0948).
